entity.summary: Centralized cryptocurrency exchange established in 2023 and providing current spot and derivatives trading markets through the Websea platform.
entity.notes: The current first-party Websea site exposes spot and derivatives trading surfaces. Current independent exchange data identifies a 2023 establishment year, British Virgin Islands registration, recently updated markets, and non-zero trading activity. The exact launch day and public contracting legal entity were not verified, so January 1 is used only as a year-level marker and confidence remains medium.

evidence.title: Websea official exchange platform
evidence.notes: The current first-party website exposes operating spot and derivatives exchange products under the Websea brand.

evidence.title: Websea exchange profile and current markets
evidence.notes: Current independent exchange profile identifies Websea as a British Virgin Islands-registered centralized exchange established in 2023 and reports recently updated markets and non-zero trading activity.
